performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG, 6.1 mm - a theoretical value for reference (FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet), which states no fill

base.description: The finger duct as FS ships #63033, both sections stacked, covers fitted.

datasheet.title: FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet

description: 45U single-sided vertical cable manager, FS SKU #63033: a black ABS finger duct with a hinged PVC cover, 2108 mm tall in two 22.5U sections, that stands beside a 45U open-frame rack on four L-brackets bolted to the side of the upright. A moulded back plate with eight oval pass-throughs carries a wall of fingers down each edge, 23 a section at one rack unit apart, and the cover clips over their tips to close a channel 93 mm wide that runs the height of the rack. It takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: two 1050 covers on the drawing make 2100; the table and the drawing's note give 2108. No document says where the 8 mm is or how far apart the two back plates stand.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the assembled duct, or a ruler on a real one

gaps.note: how far the duct stands from the upright on its L-brackets, and whether it overlaps the rail, is drawn in the guide but never dimensioned; the bracket's own sheet (VRTCMB, 45.2 wide) is the only figure. The duct is drawn without its brackets, which FS sells and draws as a separate part.
gaps.wanted: the AR201 upright and a dimensioned drawing of the bracket fitted

body.description: the back plate and the two finger walls, left first

clips.description: the cover clips on the finger tips, six a wall in each section, left wall first

cover.description: the hinged covers, one a section, the upper first

fingers.description: the fingers, the left wall top to bottom and then the right, 23 a section

name: cmv-sfd45u5w

attrs.note: datasheet - style, materials (ABS backbone, PVC cover), colour, the detachable cover, the included brackets and fixings, the 45U open rack it matches and RoHS and ISO 9001 are the specification table and Standards Compliance list of the datasheet.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom end is the top end again: the side view is the same at both ends of a section.

capacity.note: datasheet - the cable capacity table of the same datasheet (and of the Quick Start Guide V3.0) gives CMV-SFD45U5W per cable type and notes the copper figures are theoretical, for reference only; it states no fill. The figure stated is the Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm row, as for every FS manager in the library. Not divided among the fingers: FS states it for the manager.

chassis.note: drawing - THE DUCT AS IT STANDS, cover fitted: `width` across the rack's face direction, `height` the height it runs, `depth` front to back. 138.8 wide is the cover (5.46 in [138.8mm] on the cover back view; 139 on the dimensioned render), over a 125.4 body (4.94 in [125.4mm] on the back view; the table's 4.9 in, 125) centred under it - the cover is the widest thing on the part, as the 52 mm cover of the CMH-UHD-SFDABS1U is over its 44 mm ear. 165.1 deep is the side view's 6.5 in [165.1mm] from the back plate to the cover clips, the table's 6.5 in. 2108 high is the table and the drawing's note, 83 in.

clips.note: drawing - the side view draws a block in front of the tips of six fingers a section (the 3rd, 5th, 11th, 13th, 19th and 21st), reaching the 165.1 overall: the clips the cover's hinge rails snap over. The view draws one wall; the cover opens to either side (the catalogue: opens left or right), so both walls carry them, estimated.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; the cover is drawn a shade lighter than the duct, as the renders show it.

fingers-shape.note: drawing - the side view draws each finger as a bar with a hooked tip, and the slot between two fingers as a loop rounded at its root, 43.4 from the rear; laid over the render at matched scale every arm, slot, tip and clip of the section lands within 2 px (1.2 mm). A finger is drawn as a square bar 16 wide with a square tip; the small ribs along the wall roots on the back view are not drawn.

floor.note: drawing - the floor of the well is the front of the back plate, 26.9 from the rear face: the side view puts the keyed bracket slots and the plate that carries them in the last 43 px of its 266 (26.7 mm). The box section of the plate behind the floor is not built; the plate's back is the rear view's plates.

front.note: drawing - the covers, fitted. With them off the front is the channel between the two finger walls, the tips of the fingers end-on along each edge and the back plate with its pass-throughs at the bottom of it. The walls are the outer 16 mm of the 125.4 each side on the back view (21 px), so the channel is 93.4 wide. The 23 fingers of a section stand 44.44 apart (71.64 px over 22 pitches on the side view: one rack unit); an arm is 18.9 high and the gap between arms 25.5, the tip rises 21.1 above its arm and leaves a 12.4 neck to the next arm. Measured from the back plate's top on the side view, the first arm's top is 13.03 down.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the two finger walls, 93.4 wide, run down the height (`run: y`); its finger pitch is the 44.44 of the side view and its gap the 25.5 between arms.

left.note: drawing - the side view of the datasheet, both sections, rear at x=0: the back plate, the wall root, 46 arms and tips, twelve clips and the edge of the two covers, with the joint a seam.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet (page 4) draws ONE 22.5U section of CMV-SFD45U5W three ways - a back view, a side view and a cover back view - in inches with millimetres in brackets, and notes that the part is two of them, 83 in (2108mm) high. Measured on the embedded rasters at native size: the side view is 1.612 px/mm across its 165.1 and 1.612 down its 1022.4, the back view 1.276 across the 125.4 and 1.2715 down the 1022.4 (0.4 per cent apart), so both are orthographic and carry geometry to about a millimetre. The product-page renders of #63033 are the second reading (63033.g2 straight-on, 63033.x2 dimensioned, cover on and cover open), and the Quick Start Guide V3.0 steps 4 and 5 show how it mounts.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`. The Quick Start Guide V3.0 step 4 slots four L-brackets into keyed holes in the back of the duct ("The bracket is keyed to be installed in the two orientations") and step 5 bolts them with M6 screws and cage nuts to the side of the rack's upright, so the duct stands beside the rack, outside the rails, its fingers facing forward; the bracket's own datasheet (VRTCMB) says it also mounts a manager between two racks. The guide says the part suits 45U open-frame racks, and FS's compatibility matrix accepts it on the APC AR201 45U two-post only. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside. Which side of the rack is a lab placement's to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the back view: the back plate 125.4 wide, with four ovals a section on its centre line, 56 wide (2.2 in), the end two 71.8 high (2.83 in), the middle two 137.8 high (5.43 in), centred 66.1, 377.9, 644.5 and 956.3 below the top of the section's plate; each is a declared pass-through, open, through into the channel. The two keyed bracket slots a section the L-brackets hook into are painted, two blocks 37.7 wide either side of the centre line and 70.8 high, centred 176.6 and 852.9 below the plate's top. The view is symmetric about its centre line, so the rear is the back view unmirrored.

rear-not-drawn.note: drawing - the two moulded arrows a section on the back view (the direction the section stands) and the rims round the ovals are not drawn: a moulded mark is not drawn, and the rims are relief nobody has measured.

right.note: drawing - the left view mirrored: the duct is the same on both sides.

sections.note: estimated - THE TWO SECTIONS ARE DRAWN AS ONE LENGTH, the joint between them a seam. The drawing gives a section's back plate 1022.4 (40.25 in) and its cover 1050 (41.34 in), and two covers make 2100 against the stated 2108; no document places the 8 mm or says how far apart the two back plates stand. Each section is drawn as half the 2108, 1054, with its back plate centred in it (15.8 at each end) and its cover 1054 high, so the covers meet at the joint. The guide's step 5 inset shows the upper section lowered onto a peg on the lower one; the peg (18 mm on the side view) is not drawn.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT, NOT A BOX, as every FS finger duct in the library is (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4). The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: the back plate as a well 138.2 deep on the front view, its floor open at the eight pass-throughs; the two finger walls and 92 fingers standing in it; twelve cover clips a wall; and the two covers, which pull off and open the channel. The back of the plate is built as plates sunk 0.05 inside the rear face, round the pass-throughs.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states a wall gauge. 1.5 is the cover plate, drawn as a thin moulding; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the end of the duct seen from above, rear at y=0, from the side view's depths: the back plate to 26.9, the wall roots to 43.4, the topmost finger's arm to 142.7 and its tip to 152.0, the cover rails to 163.6 and the cover to 165.1. No view draws the end; it is the side view's figures laid across the back view's widths.

weight.note: datasheet - 4.75 kg, the FS product page specification table for
